limits: No independent second SPICE solution; native exported integrals/stress are checked against actual expressions and recomputed arithmetic.
Raw waveform content hashes are freshly checked, or reuse a previous full decompression only after freshly matching the exact compressed bytes.
Fixed-frame research screens are not measured BER, PVT robustness, post-layout validation or manufacturing qualification.
A partial run never claims completion, even if all currently available evidence is consistent.
